title: Network lab 1: Your first network (Filius)
summary: Install Filius, cable four computers to a switch, give them addresses, and prove with ping which ones can talk and why one can't.

script.intro: Welcome to your first network lab. We'll install Filius, a free network simulator made for schools, cable four computers to a switch, and use ping to find out why one of them can't be reached.
script.outro: That's a working network, a broken one, and the packets that explain the difference. Next we add a router.
steps: Welcome to your first network lab. We'll install Filius, a free network simulator made for schools, cable four computers to a switch, and use ping to find out why one of them can't be reached.
In design mode, drag one Switch and four Computers onto the canvas. Pick the Cable tool and click a computer, then the switch: Filius picks a free port for you. Cable all four.

Press the green arrow. Click till-1, open Software installation, add Command line, and press Apply. Open the command line and type ipconfig, then ping 192.168.1.12 and ping 192.168.1.13. Then ping 192.168.2.14.
Go back to design mode and change stray to 192.168.1.14. Run again and ping it: it answers now.
You built a network, broke it on purpose and read the packets that fixed it. Network lab 2 adds a router, so two networks can talk.
